fields.title: Packaging limits
fields.promptBlocks/0/text: Partner API. Propose a limit structure for three scenarios and state what goes into the paid tier.
fields.promptBlocks/1/items/0: Small store, updates stock once an hour
fields.promptBlocks/1/items/1: Chain of 40 stores, wants to see orders in their system immediately
fields.promptBlocks/1/items/2: Integrator connecting a new chain, initial upload of 30k items
fields.referenceReasoningBlocks/0/text: Base limit of 60/min covers the first scenario. The second requires webhooks — that is the substance of the paid tier, the limit itself doesn't solve it. The third requires a separate initial sync mode with a higher limit for a day, free of charge, otherwise onboarding hits the limit and requires manual work every time. Plus weighted counting: catalog export costs more than receiving an order.
